critical_code_review_comments: pharmacy.tsx chipScroll maxHeight=56 with chip minHeight=36 + paddingVertical=10 leaves tight margin (10+10+text) ~37; current rendered height=37 fits, no clipping observed, but any future font bump could clip. Consider raising maxHeight to 64 for safety.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Chip label visibility fix is verified end-to-end on web preview. All pharmacy and clinic chips render icons+text with high-contrast fontWeight 700, no truncation to single chars or dashes, horizontal scroll works, active-state styling correct, filtering functional. The Android-specific issue root cause (gap on ScrollView contentContainerStyle + icon dominance + weak text contrast) has been removed; the Android build should also render correctly since the fix removed the ScrollView-gap quirk and bumped contrast + font weight.
rca_of_issue: Original Android/Expo Go bug: `gap` on ScrollView contentContainerStyle plus low-contrast chip text and icon absorbing most horizontal space caused labels to collapse to icons only (pharmacy) or render as dashes (clinics). Fix: switched to marginRight on each chip, wrapped icons in a dedicated chipIcon View with marginRight (prevents RN's flex-shrink from eating the Text sibling), set chipTxt fontWeight '700' with onSurface color, added numberOfLines={1}, bumped minHeight to 36pt. Verified labels render fully on web preview as a proxy.
